genericIsolation.message: The generic command host requires Linux. Use a qualified native Codex host or an explicitly selected Linux worker.

nativeTransportBoundary: openCodexStdio clears inherited environment and uses a dedicated profile; its source explicitly states this is not an OS sandbox
limitation: The only existing generic no-network/no-ambient-files OS isolation backend requires Linux bubblewrap and rejects darwin. Launching the native transport alone cannot establish the requested no-network guarantee. No unsandboxed fallback or unqualified new sandbox profile was used.
nextQualification: Use a qualified Linux isolated worker with an explicitly supplied compatible standalone Codex binary, or separately qualify a native macOS transport isolation boundary before launching it.

Within the approved boundary, use dedicated empty HOME/CODEX_HOME and the existing checkCodexProtocol start/name/read/resume sequence, close the actual process, reopen with the saved thread ID, and verify durable local history without a model turn.

Separately obtain explicit dedicated-profile account login/host consent for one synthetic real model turn plus exact-journal disconnect/restart recovery. Generic offline command policy cannot silently gain model-network access.
Actual idle Room event delivery/resumption and saved permitted response remains separate host qualification.
